value.text:
Reitaku University (麗澤大学, Reitaku Daigaku) is a private university in Kashiwa, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. Its predecessor, Moralogy School, began in 1935; the university itself was established in 1959. Its academic structure includes the Faculty of Foreign Studies and the Faculty of Economics and Business Administration. The foreign studies offerings include English language and communication, international exchange and cooperation, German language and culture, Chinese language, and Japanese and international communication. Economics and business administration are also represented in the departmental structure.

The university offers study-abroad programmes across its departments through collaborations with overseas universities. International students come from countries in Asia, Europe and North America, including China, South Korea, Vietnam, Germany, Finland and the United States. Its listed programmes also include international management and communication, Chinese management and communication, and Japanese language study. Research in business ethics and compliance is represented by the Business Ethics and Compliance Center, which examines the legal and ethical environments in which businesses operate.
